results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT composition_formula, prototype_label
FROM oqmd_entries
WHERE prototype_label IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
ORDER BY composition_formula, prototype_label
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  oqmd_entries.composition_formula,
  oqmd_element_ratios.symbol,
  oqmd_element_ratios.atomic_ratio
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios
  ON oqmd_entries.entry_key = oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.symbol = 'Ni'
ORDER BY oqmd_entries.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT composition_formula AS formula, lattice_param_a AS lattice_a
FROM oqmd_entries
WHERE lattice_param_a < 4
ORDER BY lattice_param_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  oqmd_entries.composition_formula,
  oqmd_formation_energies.gap_ev AS band_gap_value
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_formation_energies.gap_ev IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY oqmd_formation_energies.gap_ev DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT entry_key) AS on_hull_compound_count
FROM oqmd_formation_energies
WHERE on_hull = TRUE
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  e.composition_formula,
  fe.delta_e,
  fe.hull_distance,
  fe.on_hull
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE fe.delta_e < -0.5
ORDER BY fe.hull_distance ASC, fe.on_hull DESC, fe.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  symbol AS element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT entry_key) AS entry_count
FROM oqmd_element_ratios
GROUP BY symbol
ORDER BY entry_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
    oqmd_entries.composition_formula,
    oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e,
    oqmd_formation_energies.hull_distance,
    oqmd_formation_energies.on_hull
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
    ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios
    ON oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.symbol = 'Al'
  AND oqmd_formation_energies.on_hull = TRUE
ORDER BY oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  oqmd_entries.crystal_system,
  AVG(oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e) AS avg_eform
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_entries.entry_key = oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key
GROUP BY oqmd_entries.crystal_system
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS metastable_compound_count
FROM oqmd_formation_energies
WHERE hull_distance < 0.05
  AND hull_distance > 0
  AND on_hull = false
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT e.composition_formula
FROM oqmd_entries e
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM oqmd_element_ratios er_ni
    WHERE er_ni.entry_key = e.entry_key
      AND er_ni.symbol = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM oqmd_element_ratios er_al
    WHERE er_al.entry_key = e.entry_key
      AND er_al.symbol = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY e.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  oqmd_entries.composition_formula AS formula,
  oqmd_element_ratios.symbol AS element,
  oqmd_element_ratios.wyckoff_site AS site_label,
  oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e AS formation_energy_per_atom
FROM oqmd_element_ratios
JOIN oqmd_entries
  ON oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.symbol = 'Co'
  AND oqmd_element_ratios.wyckoff_site = 'A-site'
ORDER BY oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT e.composition_formula, fe.gap_ev
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE e.spacegroup_number = 221
  AND fe.gap_ev > 0
ORDER BY fe.gap_ev DESC, e.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  symbol,
  polymorph_count,
  gs_spacegroup
FROM oqmd_reference_states
ORDER BY polymorph_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  oqmd_element_ratios.symbol AS element,
  AVG(oqmd_formation_energies.hull_distance) AS avg_hull_distance
FROM oqmd_element_ratios
JOIN oqmd_entries
  ON oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.atomic_ratio = 0.75
GROUP BY oqmd_element_ratios.symbol
ORDER BY AVG(oqmd_formation_energies.hull_distance) ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT e.composition_formula,
       fe.delta_e,
       (er_co.atomic_ratio * rs_co.energy_pa + er_ti.atomic_ratio * rs_ti.energy_pa) AS weighted_reference_energy,
       fe.delta_e - (er_co.atomic_ratio * rs_co.energy_pa + er_ti.atomic_ratio * rs_ti.energy_pa) AS calculated_formation_enthalpy
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios er_co ON er_co.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_elements el_co ON el_co.symbol = er_co.symbol
JOIN oqmd_reference_states rs_co ON rs_co.symbol = el_co.symbol
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios er_ti ON er_ti.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_elements el_ti ON el_ti.symbol = er_ti.symbol
JOIN oqmd_reference_states rs_ti ON rs_ti.symbol = el_ti.symbol
WHERE e.composition_formula = 'Co3Ti'
  AND er_co.symbol = 'Co'
  AND er_ti.symbol = 'Ti'
ORDER BY calculated_formation_enthalpy
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT oqmd_entries.composition_formula,
       oqmd_entries.prototype_label,
       oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_formation_energies.on_hull = TRUE
  AND (
    oqmd_entries.prototype_label = 'L12'
    OR oqmd_entries.prototype_label = 'L1₂'
    OR oqmd_entries.prototype_label = 'L1_2'
  )
  AND oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e < -0.3
ORDER BY oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  r.symbol AS a_site,
  AVG(f.delta_e) AS avg_formation_enthalpy
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies f ON f.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios r ON r.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE e.prototype_label = 'L12'
  AND f.on_hull = TRUE
  AND r.wyckoff_site = 'A-site'
GROUP BY r.symbol
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy ASC
LIMIT 10000;
